concern_summary: This concern pertains to the functionality of flagging comments on the report page. It involves selecting a severity level for flagging and managing the state related to the page's reload status.
This concern focuses on the display and interaction aspects of the Income Outgoing User Report, including managing payment confirmations and updating the report with the latest transaction details.

This concern addresses the display and navigation logic associated with the report page, focusing on viewing detailed reports, managing report-specific settings, and retrieving the correct report data during user interactions.

This concern encapsulates the functionalities related to managing financial codes (Payroll Code and General Ledger Code) and transaction categorization under a specific policy, ensuring that users can effectively edit, save, and reflect these financial settings in the report page.

This concern involves the functionality related to the transaction receipt page and transaction review page, ensuring the correct display and management of transaction details, including identifying validity and contextual information about transactions.

This concern manages the navigation and exit strategies for the report page, ensuring users can appropriately dismiss modals or navigate to fallback routes when leaving the bank account setup process.
This concern relates to the validation and submission of limits for auto reimbursement on the auto pay reports page, ensuring compliance with predefined maximum values.

This concern focuses on managing and aggregating financial data within the report page, including the validation and rendering of reports based on input and output transactions, as well as calculations of differences in amounts and updates to reflect accurate totals.
This concern addresses the processing and management of report entries, including handling errors, pending actions, and adjustments to existing reports and their related comments.
